metrics_definitions.answer_correctness: Does the response match expected answer type, verdict, and key factual parameters?
metrics_definitions.citation_accuracy: Does the response cite the expected authoritative document and section?
metrics_definitions.abstention_accuracy: Does the system refuse unauthorized requests and report not_found for out-of-scope inquiries?
metrics_definitions.tool_correctness: Does the deterministic calculation match the exact mathematical/database truth?
metrics_definitions.retrieval_hit_rate: Did retrieval return the expected authoritative document among candidates?
metrics_definitions.latency: End-to-end request turnaround time in milliseconds (P50 and P95).
